en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a formal procession of men in long overcoats, tailcoats and top hats walking in rows along a broad paved area in front of a large, ornate neoclassical building with rusticated lower stories and tall columns above. Some men carry canes; onlookers stand farther back. A large vertical flagpole or banner is visible at the right edge. The image has the look of an early‑20th‑century civic or diplomatic ceremony.
